citation: Meyer-Gerspach AC, Cajacob L, Riva D, et al. Mechanisms Regulating Insulin Response to Intragastric Glucose in Lean and Non-Diabetic Obese Subjects: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Parallel-Group Trial. PLoS ONE. 2016.
protocol: Intragastric (tube) glucose loads of 10, 25 and 75 g in water; 180 min sampling
population: n=12 lean (6 M, 6 F; age 24.3+/-0.6; BMI 22.0+/-0.4) and n=12 non-diabetic obese (6 M, 6 F; BMI 38.8+/-0.9)

reports.marker: glucose, insulin, glucagon, GLP-1, GIP time courses

note: Glucose given by tube into the stomach, not drunk; three doses give a dose-response in lean vs obese. Table 1 is summary statistics (fasting, peak, iAUC), not per-time values. Obese arm non-healthy.
